title: Shueisha says birth dates of Jump Characters Store members leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
date_note: 26 November is the day Shueisha announced the leak, per Cybersecurity.com (Japan); the page gives no earlier disclosure day. The access to KARTE was on 13 November per the article.
geo_basis: Japan, as the company and publisher are Japanese; no city stated in the source read
summary: Cybersecurity.com (Japan) reports that Shueisha announced on 26 November that, after unauthorized access to Plaid's KARTE, birth dates of 70万7,852件 (707,852) Jump Characters Store members and their gender leaked. The article says names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, passwords and credit card information were not included, and no secondary harm has been confirmed, according to Shueisha.
plain: Shueisha says birth dates and gender of Jump Characters Store members leaked from vendor Plaid's KARTE service. It says names, addresses, passwords and card data were not included.
exec: Shueisha says 70万7,852件 (707,852) member birth-date records leaked via a vendor's marketing tool; it reports no secondary harm so far.
action: Shueisha's 17 November notice, as relayed by Cybersecurity.com (Japan), said suspicious emails impersonating Shueisha or Plaid could be sent.

evidence.quote: 集英社は11月26日、プレイドの「KARTE」への不正アクセスで、「ジャンプキャラクターズストア」会員の生年月日70万7,852件と性別が漏えいしたと発表した。

validation.note: Only Cybersecurity.com (Japan) read; it relays Shueisha's 26 November announcement. Shueisha's PDF notice could not be read (binary).

review.note: action advice: said Shueisha urges users; source only says the 17 Nov notice warned suspicious emails could be sent; reworded. Figure 707,852, date, exclusions checked
